text: Could you make a reel from these five café photos I’ve attached? I’ve been looking forward to putting these together, but I’m not very good at making a set of photos feel like one video. What I mean is a 10-second vertical Instagram reel, using all five pictures in the order attached: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Please add some relaxed instrumental music to go with them. I’m hoping this will be a nice way to share the café photos rather than just leaving them sitting on my phone. There shouldn’t be any text, just nice smooth transitions between the photos.
